messages:
Mira: Heads-up — sunset change window tonight 21:00-23:00 PT. Quiet runway starts 20:45. Please post any last-minute exemptions or deploy blockers here. Exit criteria at the bottom.

Sam: ACK. I'm owning smoke + perf probes. Will run the perf probe at T-30.

Alex: Oncall shadow here. I will watch latency and error budget during the first 15m of canary. If we see >5% increase in 5xxs we roll back.

Jamie: small docs nit — release notes v3.1.2 are staged in the repo (link). No content changes after quiet runway please.

Mira: Deploy pin list:
- user-service -> v3.1.2 (pinned)
- embed-service -> v2.9.7 (pinned, no change)
- runtime -> v5.4.0 -> will canary v5.4.1 (gradual)

Mira: Exemptions? Any last-minute hotfix requests must include an owner and rollback plan.

Alex: Quick ask: we have a warming job that touches cache; want to delay it until after 22:00 to avoid noise on the SLOs. Sam ok?

Sam: +1 delay warming until 22:05. I'll coordinate.

DeployBot: Scheduled canary rollout: service=runtime, from=v5.4.0 to=v5.4.1, strategy=staggered-canary(10%->50%->100%), start=1728460199 (approx 21:03 PT). Monitoring hooks attached.

SRE-Bot: Alert policy check: smoke tests configured, synthetic latency probe active. Thresholds: p95 > 300ms OR error-rate > 0.5% triggers paging. Link: https://monitoring/redwood/probes/1712

Mira: Quick checklist (copy/paste into your own notes):
```
[ ] Quiet runway announced (20:45)
[ ] Release notes frozen and linked
[ ] Pins verified in deploybot and manifest
[ ] Smoke tests ready and owners assigned (Sam)
[ ] Canary schedule created (DeployBot)
[ ] Rollback playbook ready and owner assigned (Alex)
[ ] Post-deploy warming delayed until 22:05
[ ] Stakeholders oncall and aware (prod, eng, infra)
```

Jamie: Pins verified on my side. Release notes link: https://git/repo/releases/3.1.2

Alex: Rollback plan reminder: immediate unpin + deploy previous stable (v5.4.0) via deploybot rollback command. Owners: Alex (exec), Sam (smoke verify), Mira (stakeholder comms).

Sam: Running a dry smoke now (T-45). Will post results in 10m.

Mira: If smoke/dry run passes and no new blockers, we proceed with canary at 21:03. Everyone please react :thumbsup: when you confirm ready.

Sam: smoke dry run: PASS. no errors, latency within baseline.

Alex: watching dashboards, nothing weird in the last 10m.

Jamie: release notes published, no new content.

Mira: All green from owners. Proceeding to canary at 21:03. If you see anything, call for rollback immediately with the reasoning and metric evidence.

DeployBot: Canary started — 10% traffic shifted to runtime:v5.4.1. Logs: `deploy/1728460199/canary-step1`

SRE-Bot: Canary health check OK at 5m window. p95 240ms, errors 0.12%.

Alex: Looks stable. Hold for 10 more minutes then proceed to 50%.

Mira: 21:12 update: ramp to 50% approved. Sam continue probes.

DeployBot: Canary ramped to 50%. Logs: `deploy/1728460520/canary-step2`

SRE-Bot: Health check OK after ramp. No alerts triggered.

Mira: Final ramp to 100% in 5m if no regressions. Post-deploy warming scheduled at 22:05.

Sam: Affirmative — will run extended perf probe at 22:10 and report.

Mira: Thanks team. Marking this thread closed after post-deploy checks. :rocket:
